name: 32505 · Pensacola, FL
findings: ZIP 32505 (Pensacola) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32505 (Pensacola) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
